posix:
HISTFILE=;
SA_OS_TYPE="Linux"
REAL_OS_NAME=$(uname -s)
if [ "$REAL_OS_NAME" != "$SA_OS_TYPE" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$REAL_OS_NAME"
elif [ -r /etc/os-release ]; then
  cat /etc/os-release
elif [ -r /usr/lib/os-release ]; then
  cat /usr/lib/os-release
else
  uname -s
  cat /etc/*release
fi
fish:
if test (uname -s) = Linux
  if test -r /etc/os-release
    cat /etc/os-release
  else if test -r /usr/lib/os-release
    cat /usr/lib/os-release
  else
    uname -s
    cat /etc/*release
  end
else
  uname -s
end
